content.text: I've compared the brief line by line against the release. Summary: the figures the brief does report are accurate, but it omits GAAP EPS, GAAP operating margin, the cash flow statement items, and the IEEPA tariff-refund qualifier embedded in guidance.

facts.evidence: Second quarter sales increased to $47.9 billion, up 5.7% from $45.3 billion in the same period last year.
Adjusted diluted earnings per share were $4.92, up from $4.68 in the prior year.
Comparable sales grew by 1.7%, with U.S. comparable sales increasing by 1.3%.
The company reaffirms its fiscal 2026 guidance, expecting total sales growth of approximately 2.5% to 4.5%.
Comparable sales growth was driven by a 2.8% increase in the average ticket, partially offset by a decline in customer transactions.

claims.claim: Second quarter sales were $47.9 billion, an increase of 5.7% from the same period last year.
Prior-year second quarter sales were $45.3 billion.
Comparable sales grew 1.7% in the second quarter.
U.S. comparable sales increased 1.3% in the second quarter.
Net earnings for the second quarter were $4.8 billion, compared with $4.6 billion in the second quarter of 2025.
Adjusted diluted earnings per share were $4.92, up from $4.68 in the prior-year quarter.
Broad-based demand across the business contributed to the quarter's performance.
Average ticket increased 2.8%.
Customer transactions declined, partially offsetting the increase in average ticket.
The company reaffirmed its fiscal 2026 guidance.
Fiscal 2026 guidance calls for total sales growth of approximately 2.5% to 4.5%.
Fiscal 2026 comparable sales growth is guided to approximately flat to 2.0%.
Adjusted diluted EPS is expected to grow approximately flat to 4.0% from $14.69 in fiscal 2025.
Capital expenditures are expected to be approximately 2.5% of total sales.
The company plans to open approximately 15 new stores in fiscal 2026.
